name: g_regexPredefinedClassRangeTable
comment: Master lookup table of 2,574 Unicode code-point ranges used by regex predefined character classes (POSIX classes and Unicode script/block names such as \p{Lower}, \p{ASCII}, \p{InGreek}). Each 4-byte entry encodes a {u16 start, u16 end} code-point interval inserted into a character set by Regex_Set_AddPredefinedClass.
evidence: Referenced at literal 0x005142C8 in Regex_Set_AddPredefinedClass (0x00514264). Indexed as `puVar3 = (u16 *)(0x00754FC8 + i * 4)` for `i` from `first_index` to `first_index + count - 1` taken from g_regexPredefinedClassDescriptorTable (0x00757800). Each 4-byte entry stores `{start, end}` passed to Regex_Set_AddRange (0x0051384C). Exactly 2,574 entries (10,296 bytes = 0x2838) spanning 0x00754FC8 to 0x00757800 in rodata_00745000.s.

name: g_regexPredefinedClassDescriptorTable
comment: Descriptor slice table for the 132 predefined regex character classes (class IDs 0..0x83). Each 8-byte entry stores a {u32 firstRangeIndex, u32 rangeCount} pair indexing the range runs in g_regexPredefinedClassRangeTable (0x00754FC8).
evidence: Referenced at literal 0x005142C4 in Regex_Set_AddPredefinedClass (0x00514264): `piVar5 = (int *)(0x00757800 + class_id * 8);` reads `first_index = piVar5[0]` and `count = piVar5[1]`. Table contains exactly 132 (0x84) 8-byte entries (1,056 bytes = 264 words) immediately following g_regexPredefinedClassRangeTable and spanning 0x00757800 to 0x00757C20 in rodata_00745000.s.

name: g_regexPredefinedClassNameTable
comment: Name lookup table for the 132 predefined regex character classes matched by Regex_ParsePredefinedClass when parsing '\p{Name}' or '\P{Name}'. Each 8-byte entry contains {const wchar_t* nameWithBrace, u32 length} (e.g. 'Lower}', 'Upper}', 'ASCII}', 'InLatin-1Supplement}').
evidence: Referenced at literal 0x00514338 in Regex_ParsePredefinedClass (0x005142CC). Loop iterates entries 0..0x83 as `piVar4 = (int *)(0x00757C20 + uVar3 * 8)`, comparing string at piVar4[0] of length piVar4[1] via std_Utf16CompareN (0x00100AD6) and returning class ID uVar3 on match. Spans exactly 132 (0x84) 8-byte entries (1,056 bytes = 264 words) from 0x00757C20 to 0x00758040 in rodata_00745000.s.

name: g_regexOpcodeDispatchTable
comment: Regex pattern VM opcode dispatch table in .data containing 38 8-byte {void* handler, u32 flagsOrCtxOffset} entries split into two 19-opcode parallel sub-tables: match handlers at +0x00..+0x90 and advance handlers at +0x98..+0x128, dispatched by maybe_Regex_MatchLoop and Regex_MatchSequence.
evidence: Referenced at literals 0x00510E4C in maybe_Regex_MatchLoop (0x00510D58) and 0x00511770 in Regex_MatchSequence (0x0051150C). Both functions compute match table base 0x007AF1B0 and advance table base 0x007AF1B0 + 0x98 (0x007AF248), indexing by `node_type * 8` (19 opcodes, 0..18). Handlers include Regex_OpPushValueAndVariants (0x00512338), Regex_OpCopySetAndPush (0x00511DC0), Regex_OpPushNamedClass (0x00512624), Regex_OpBuildOperandSets (0x00511774), and default advance 0x00511B34. Total size 304 bytes (76 words) from 0x007AF1B0 to 0x007AF2E0.
